part.text:
Built the complete course registration app in `/work`:

- `index.html` – home page with hero search, departments, featured courses
- `catalog.html` – searchable/filterable catalog with 15 courses
- `register.html` – validated registration form, course preview, confirmation modal, registered-courses table
- `profile.html` – editable student profile, stats, and registered-course management
- Shared responsive colorful styling in `styles.css`, with data/state in `data.js` and `store.js`

Registrations persist via `localStorage` with an in-memory fallback. All pages were tested for JavaScript errors and core interactions with headless DOM tests; all checks passed.
